jp: なんつー高さだよ・・・
en: Hieeeeeee~ What kind of height is this...
Fall from here and you're dead, no question!
Exal...

jp: 力の限りしがみつかれると
さすがに飛びづらいのだが・・
en: When you cling on with all your might, it is rather hard to fly..
Whoa! S-sorry!! I'll let go right--
Waaaaaaaaah!
Exal!!
..S-sorry, Valtoss-sama.

jp: お前の命の恩人になるのは
en: That makes twice now I've saved your life.
S-sorry..
Fall from the sky, a little high or terribly high, and everyone dies the same.

jp: こんなところで怖い話は
en: V-Valtoss-sama! No scary talk in a place like this!!
It only looks different. It is no different from where we just flew in from.

jp: 普通につかまっていなさい
en: Just hold on normally, the same as you have been.
Y-yes, sir!

jp: 向こうの話が聞こえただろう？
en: You heard them over there, right?

jp: 落ちたら死ぬんでしょ！！！
en: I-I heard! Fall and you die, right!?

jp: 空にいる限り高さなど
今さら関係ないという話の方だ
en: No. The part about how height stops mattering once you're already in the sky.

jp: でも怖いものは怖いのよッ！！
en: I-I know that! But scary is scary!!

jp: だから、首を締め上げるな！
お前はオレを殺す気か！！
en: Then stop strangling me! Are you trying to kill me!!

jp: だって、こんな高い場所
怖がるなっていう方が無理よ！！
en: But asking me not to be scared this high up is impossible!!
Are you not afraid?
No, I'm fine.

jp: ザイオンさんが心配ですね
en: If anything, I'm worried about big sis and Zion-san.
Indeed.

jp: 遺跡群が見えるだろう
en: You can see the ruins atop the World Tree, can you not?
Ah, you're right! Buildings on top of a tree!?

jp: でも、どうしてこんな場所に・・
en: But why in a place like this..

jp: 多くの世界樹の上には
あのように遺跡群が存在する
en: Atop many of the World Trees, ruins like those exist.

jp: いつごろ、なんのために
あのような場所に遺跡が造られた
のかはわかっていない
en: When they were built in such places, and for what purpose, no one knows.

jp: 一説には、世界が大洪水にのまれ
逃げ延びた者達が世界樹の上で
暮らしていたという話もある
en: By one theory a great flood drowned the world; survivors lived atop the World Trees.

jp: こんな高いところにですか？
en: In a place this high up?

jp: 世界樹の上に住んでいた者達が
我々の祖先だという伝説だ・・・
en: Yes. The legend says those who lived atop the World Trees were our ancestors...

jp: こんな高いところじゃ
翼のない人達はどうやって
ここまで来たんだろう・・・
en: This high up... how did people without wings ever get up here, I wonder...

jp: 翼ある者の助けを借りれば
en: With help from the Winged Ones, it would be possible.
I see... Of course.

jp: 僕達、翼なき者が地上にいる以上
en: If the legend is true, then since we, the wingless, are on the ground now,

jp: 心優しい翼ある者達が
いたってことですよね
en: there must have been kind-hearted Winged Ones who helped the wingless, right?
Yes, that is so.
Uuuuu....
Are you all right, Lilis?

jp: 自力で飛ぶのは・・・・
en: As I thought, flying on your own is still....
Lilis is fine! Lilis got Luca's wings!

jp: リリスはルカみたいに
孤高で格好いい女・・
en: Lilis is a cool, solitary woman, just like Luca..
Wh-whoa!!
Lilis!

jp: どうしてうまく飛べないの？
en: Uuuuu... Why can't Lilis fly right?

jp: 最初は誰でもうまく飛べませんわ
en: Nobody flies well at first.

jp: 自分の力で飛ぶのなら
せめて手ぐらいつなぎましょう
en: If you're flying on your own, at least let's hold hands.
Okay.

jp: でも、リリス頑張るからね
絶対に孤高の女になるの！
en: But Lilis will do her best! Lilis will be a solitary woman for sure!

jp: 少しずつ頑張りましょうね
en: Yes, so let's do our best, a little at a time.
Yeah, Lilis will do her best!!
Matia....

jp: ギシャァァァァァァァ！！！
en: GSHAAAAAAAA!!

jp: こんなところに、パスカが！？
en: Pasca, in a place like this!?

jp: パスカがいるってことは
アベルまでの距離は近い・・・
en: If Pasca's here, Abel can't be far...
Everyone, let's go!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
